correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all connected labeled simple graphs n=2..5 (1,4,38,728), every opinion state and exact positive transition support, and terminal SCC via networkx. Found zero stochastic terminal classes for n<=4, exactly 135 labeled at n=5; canonical graph isomorphisms identify bull/house/wheel with orbit sizes 60,60,15. Direct local neighbor counts show the four-state alternating phase closure for each witness. For every n>=5, leaf-augmented bull strict majorities force phase change and a unique tied vertex continues independent randomness; finite enumeration is not used as the infinite-family proof.

value.rationale: An exact smallest-order phase boundary and COMPLETE first exceptional graph classification for a natural finite Markov process are independently useful. The labeled/unlabeled enumeration and all-order bull family distinguish it from a one-off witness; the result does not purport to classify all larger graphs.

final_claim: In synchronous neighbor-majority with independent fair ties on connected simple graphs n>=2, stochastic absorbing classes first occur at n=5 and exactly for bull, house and wheel (135 labeled instances); four-state classes exist for every n>=5 by pendant-bull construction.
